data.narrative:
SandboxAQ, founded by Jack Hidary, is a Series E AI & Software company seeking valuation support at its current post-money of $5.8B. The peer universe consists of 9 comparable companies across AI and software infrastructure—1 public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms including Wayve, Ayar Labs, Applied Intuition, Figure AI, and Scale AI, predominantly at Series D through Series F stages.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement, yielding $8.0B from the $5.8B last post-money. Peer-median analysis draws from three same-sector, adjacent-stage comparables: Applied Intuition at $15.0B (Series F), Wayve at $8.6B (Series D), and Ayar Labs at $3.8B (Series E), producing a median of $8.6B and a range of $3.8B to $15.0B.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $6.8B (low) to $9.9B (high), with a median of $8.3B. This median sits 44% above the current $5.8B valuation. Key uncertainties include the stage dispersion within the peer set—Applied Intuition's Series F status and substantially higher valuation ($15.0B) represent an upside case, while Ayar Labs at Series E and $3.8B suggests material downside sensitivity to company-specific metrics and traction not captured in stage alone.
